correctness.rationale: The geometric minimum survival is summed exactly. Substitution of the unit-Weibull density and CDF gives an exact hazard formula. At the right endpoint, \(1-G(x)\sim\alpha(-\log x)^\beta\), the geometric multiplier tends to one, and \(g(x)\sim\alpha\beta(-\log x)^{\beta-1}/x\), yielding \((1-x)h(x)\to\beta\). The shape exclusions follow immediately from terminal divergence. The left-endpoint classification follows from \(h(x)\sim(\alpha\beta/(1-\rho))t^{\beta-1}e^{t-\alpha t^\beta}\) with \(t=-\log x\).

value.rationale: Hazard-shape flexibility is a central reliability motivation of the new model and is highlighted in the article abstract. The exact endpoint law removes two advertised global regimes for every parameter value, explains why finite-window plots can be misleading, and gives a useful left-endpoint classification. This is a structural boundary result, not a parameter-grid observation or cosmetic correction.
